how_to_use_markdown:
It returns the difference between the Best Bid and the best Ask Price of the selected Instrument

![Example](./images/img-1631703870.png)

Note - Bid/Ask Difference is returned only if there is a change in the bid and the ask in the last tick, else  returns 0 .
